reply_text:
I found four 2026 predictions from Pichai that carry a date or a time span, and none of them is one of the two you've already recorded. Two come from Google's own pages, one from a third-party machine transcript and one only from a news report. I used 9 of the 12 searches and all 6 page openings.

1. **28 October, Q3 earnings call** (Google's edited transcript of his remarks): "I would expect the next 12 months to see continued acceleration because of RSI." Earlier in the same paragraph he says AI is "helping us increase our training and launch velocity."
2. **7 April, Cheeky Pint podcast** (the episode's published transcript): "The models are going to be dramatically different in a year's time."
3. **Late May, Decoder with Nilay Patel** (recorded just after I/O, published 26 May): "the way I would answer that question three years from now, whether you and I call it AGI or not doesn't matter because it'll be very, very powerful and we have to prepare for it." I saw this only as a quoted line, timestamped 45:38, on Blumify's machine-transcript page. The full transcript was behind a sign-in. Check it against the video or The Verge's transcript before you use it.
4. **I/O week, The Rundown interview** (newsletter dated 22 May): only the reporter's paraphrase, not Pichai's words. It says AI agents will be "very common three years from now" and today's technology will look as primitive as flip phones.

**What I left out:**
- **Gemini 3.5 Pro "next month":** news reports say Pichai told the I/O audience on 19 May to "give us until next month." The I/O keynote page I opened was cut off before the Gemini models section, so I never read those words. This is a strong lead worth checking against the keynote video.
- **Gemini Omni API "in the coming weeks":** this line is on the I/O page, but "coming weeks" is as vague as "soon."
- **AGI timing on Decoder:** Blumify's summary has him saying AGI is "sooner rather than later" and that people argue over "three or five years." That is the summary's wording, not a transcript, so I didn't list it as undated either.
- **Search in 10 years (Cheeky Pint):** asked whether Search will exist in 10 years, he said "Search would be an agent manager." The 10 years was in the interviewer's question, not his answer.
- **Business, infrastructure and non-AI forecasts:** spending, data centres in space and a quantum computing prediction.

**Not checked:**
- A Big Technology Podcast appearance around 23 October about self-improving AI ("RSI").
- His India AI Impact Summit speech (19 February), where a third-party transcript shows a line about "the next decade or two decades."
- The June investor presentation and the Q2 earnings remarks.
